title: Recent advances in luminescent lanthanide based Single-Molecule Magnets
claim: Chiral or polar luminescent Ln SMMs can add NCD, SHG, piezo/pyroelectricity, magneto-chiral dichroism, magnetization-induced second-harmonic generation, and circularly polarized luminescence, and crystallization in a polar group can add ferroelectricity.
explanation: Chirality in Ln SMMs has been reported to enhance slow relaxation relative to a racemic mixture through a different packing. MChD and MSHG are proposed as optical readouts of magnetization, while CPL in luminescent Ln SMMs is described as relatively unexplored. Only three photoluminescent ferroelectric SMMs are cited; a homochiral Zn/Dy Schiff-base complex in P21 shows correlated magnetism and luminescence, thermal robustness to 573 K, and electrical hysteresis up to 563 K, above the comparison drawn with BaTiO3.
scope: Chiral or polar multifunctional Ln SMMs, including the enantiopure Zn2+/Dy3+ Schiff-base ferroelectric.
conditions: Non-centrosymmetric or polar crystal structures, often from chiral ligands.
caveats: Most cross-effects (MChD, MSHG, magneto-electric coupling) are presented as opportunities rather than results demonstrated across the family. The record electrical-hysteresis temperature is one cited molecular example.
